legacy_preservation.method: Remove the exact appended CPUFREQ_DOMAINS/capture_cpufreq_hw block and the exact one try/except insertion, then compare bytes with the original Git blob.
legacy_preservation.note: The complete inherited wrapper includes its existing private AOP mailbox read and diagnostic launch flow. The new CPUFreq capture function itself uses only query-status and qom-get.

new_observer_behavior.status_guards: Before any reads, require a dictionary with running exactly False and nonempty string status. In a finally block, query again and require stopped and the identical status, even when a QOM read fails.
new_observer_behavior.schema_guards: Exact Python bool/int types, unsigned/signed widths, supported performance/limit/status/phase ranges. bool is never accepted as an int.
new_observer_behavior.configuration_guards: Actual DT geometry/masks/max_cores and reference profile geometry are evaluated independently of device-returned counts; loops remain bounded by fixed 3 domains, 40 rows and the actual 4/3/1 CPU membership.
new_observer_behavior.raw_state: Requested/effective L and rate, selected voltage descriptor, limit input, IRQ latch and level, known frequency, input Clock rates, sampled count/phase and stored count/phase/epoch are retained. Counter getters are pure calculations in the reviewed C and do not commit state.
new_observer_behavior.irq_semantics: Checks IRQ level against the latch, not against the limited condition. A stale latched event after lifting a cap and a cleared event during unchanged restriction are both legitimate.
new_observer_behavior.unknown_profile: Configuration remains observable, raw state is explicitly unavailable and the overall observation is inconclusive.
new_observer_behavior.observation_status: complete means a coherent stopped reference snapshot was collected. A zero/unknown XO or cold zero count does not become a driver or progress verdict.
nonclaims: counter progress from a single snapshot
physical voltage, execution rate or WFI power gating

isolated_validation.test_method: AST-select only CPUFREQ_DOMAINS assignment and capture_cpufreq_hw into an isolated namespace, then drive a fake QMP callable. No existing wrapper import, diagnostic main, QEMU process, native run or device connection.

additional_c_review.wide_counter_arithmetic: Verified current QEMU host-utils.h divu128 returns the full 128-bit quotient through low/high plus exact remainder. Retaining quotient low 32 bits and carry from saved phase implements modulo-2^32 exactly.
additional_c_review.transition_order: Updates settle the cached old rate before deriving the new PERF/limit/Clock rate.
additional_c_review.reset_and_migration: SysBus participates in reset tree; reset preserves external cap/provider inputs and clears count/latch; incoming count+phase is reanchored at target virtual time, IRQ is restored before first MMIO, and normal post_load avoids downstream Clock callbacks.
additional_c_review.board_wiring: Three actual physical resources and SPI30/31/19 map to the GIC, XO uses the board carrier, alternate is the real GCC gpll0 output.
